en: This postcard image depicts a tranquil lakeside or seaside scene with two large foreground trees and three people (possibly two adults and a child) sitting or standing on a grassy bank, gazing out over the water. In the background, across the water, there are small islands – one of which appears to feature a monastery or church complex with a red-tiled roof, and a cluster of buildings. The setting is lush and hilly, likely Mediterranean. There is faint text at the bottom, partially in Greek and partially in Roman characters.
